newsitem.title: GERMANY: FOCUS-Forex market overreacting, says Waigel.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS-Forex market overreacting, says Waigel.

text.p: Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Tuesday that Germany wanted a strong mark and that he believed the dollar and pound's strength against the mark was an overreaction by the market.
"We are interested in a strong deutschemark. I think what's happening at the moment is an overreaction of the markets," he told a news conference.

Germany stood by previous agreements on foreign exchange rates within the Group of Seven (G7) industrialised nations. "We have, as in the past, agreed cooperation within the G7." he said. "We are in contact with our partners."
The dollar slipped against the mark in European morning trade due to Waigel's comments, made during a visit to Berlin by the leadership of his Christian Social Union party.
The Bundesbank declined to comment on market speculation that it was checking mark prices in the foreign exchange market.
Currency dealers earlier said the central bank was checking mark prices but there was no confirmation of concrete action.
The dollar hit the highest level against the mark since October 1990 on Monday.
